mode: explicit invocation; workflow adherence, not automatic triggering
baseline: actual preserved read-but-skipped incident; no paid baseline rerun
isolation: fresh Bubblewrap home/state/cache/workspace/PID namespace per case; no personal configs or other task files; shared read-only toolchain and network/provider caches
tools: native shell/web/image with read-only resvg and Playwright; no imagegen, subagents, MCP/apps/remote plugins
grading: frozen README criteria plus actual trace/source/image audit; no model judge; no coordinator artwork edits or in-run reminders
retry_policy: no automatic retries or extra sessions; failed/budget results retained
cost: time and observed tool-start caps; no native hard token/dollar cap; report actual usage
mechanical_limits: receipt checker is voluntarily invoked by actor, not a host hook; cannot attest actual viewing or prevent direct source edits
not_covered: original five-entity artwork repair, general reliability, statistical A/B effects and implicit trigger rates
